verdict.rationale: Formant's own marketing says users can 'ask your fleet what's happening in plain language' and get governed, ML-driven task recommendations that people approve. Its fleet orchestration assigns and dispatches jobs to robots. This comes close to natural-language-to-task planning with human-in-the-loop execution, but the NL interface is framed around querying and recommendations rather than expressing an arbitrary task and having it planned and run. Missing for 10: documented NL task-expression interface, evidence of automatic plan-to-execution of NL-specified tasks, technical docs beyond marketing pages, independent/hands-on corroboration.
